item.title: Lysdotos #8629 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The House of Pelorus mad
item.description: Lysdotos #8629 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The House of Pelorus made room at the fire, but no one sat close. Lysdotos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: Pythkrates #8699 caught Thrasnikos #4680 the Twice-Born alone in the Reef and left them bleeding. Not dead. Not yet.

item.title: Glaukphon #4180 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphode
item.description: Glaukphon #4180 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Glaukgenes #7955 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to Bear Mountain.

item.description: Dorkrates #9142 the Twice-Born of the House of Chthonius fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend. Dorkrates has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
